title: Reading a protected shared increment
description: You can follow the supplied mutex and thread lifecycle.

steps.description: counter starts at zero and lock is a shared mutex. ITERATIONS sets the number of loop passes for each worker.
Each worker locks before updating counter and unlocks afterward. You can locate the shared read and write inside this protected region.

steps.question: Does main print the count before either worker finishes?
steps.answer: No. It joins both threads before reaching the print statement.

steps.description: main initializes the mutex, starts and joins both workers, then destroys the mutex. You see Final count: 2000000 (expected 2000000) in the supplied run.
